copy.curiosityHook: What cosmic truths await across the stars, and where will the trail to Meg's missing father lead?
copy.description: Following her scientist father's sudden disappearance, young Meg embarks on an interstellar search alongside her brother and friend after three mysterious beings send them voyaging across space.
copy.vibeSummary: An exciting, medium-paced family space quest balancing adventurous wonder with moderate emotional stakes.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Ava DuVernay, this imaginative adventure blends family drama with sweeping cosmic fantasy, delivering an earnest, visually driven quest across space.
